belief: Robert Zemeckis has directed many movies, including Back to the Future, Forrest Gump, Who Framed Roger Rabbit, Cast Away, Contact, The Polar Express, Romancing the Stone, Flight, Allied, and others.

author: worker_2
belief: Robert Zemeckis is considered a renowned and famous film director, having won two Academy Awards (including Best Director for Forrest Gump), a Golden Globe, and directed many critically acclaimed and commercially successful films such as Back to the Future, Forrest Gump, and Who Framed Roger Rabbit.
